Name: Chrono Furniture for DGA
Author: ZephiraZ
Description:
This mod ports some objects from the SNES game Chrono Trigger as furniture using the Dynamic Game Assets framework.
This is a conversion of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12769]Chrono Furniture for Custom Furniture[/url] pack. This DGA version currently contains all the same items as the CF version, with some differences:
[list]
[*]Chairs now work!
[*]Certain items that looked like they should produce light are now classified as lamps!
[*]Decorations can go on tables! Except for the decorations that are larger than one tile. Sorry, gotta eat your Dorinan Fish and Hyper Kabob on the floor.
[/list]
Known issues:
[list]
[*]The Fiendish Summoning Statue, which is a lamp, only emits light from the left side instead of the whole sprite. Game limitation?
[*]A lot of item descriptions are too long and go off the screen. Word wrap worked fine in the CF pack, not sure what the difference is. Will research later.
[*]Decorations that can rotate, the Dorinan Bottle and Dorinan Dinner Plate, only display their main orientation when placed on a table. Game limitation?
[*]The Dorinan Clock sits really high on the wall. Research later.
[*]I want to make second copies of some items that can be centered to line up with beds or rugs, like the Slasher, Fiendish Throne, and some statues.
[*]Animation is a little weird on Fiendish Summoning Statue, Fiendish Candelabra, and Fiendish Flame. May adjust later.
[/list]
Note that these are not hand drawn, but ports of the exact sprites.
